It binds the run to the plan digest and exact check set, requires per-check result digests, separates missing/unknown/duplicate/failed/skipped/cancelled states, and emits a structural release-candidate signal without contacting GitHub, verifying provider signatures, fetching logs, or executing checks.

ci.description: Canonical CiRequest used to regenerate the workflow plan: workflow, triggers, rust_toolchain, checks, and optional offline.

evidence.description: CiRunEvidence with run_id, provider, source, plan_digest, conclusion, checks, and optional environment_digest/run_url. Each check requires a valid result_digest.

name: execution_provenance_audit
description: Reconcile a returned agent mission report with its embedded plan, terminal step results, deterministic trace ordering, and optional delegated check evidence. It recomputes trace/provenance digests and emits a bounded structural readiness signal without replaying the mission, contacting providers, or approving deployment, security, scientific, clinical, or release authority.

mission.description: The exact MissionReport returned by agent_mission, including plan, results, execution_trace, execution, and mission_status.

delegated_checks.description: Optional check evidence attached to the mission. Each row needs name, kind, required, status, result_digest, source, and may reference a mission trace sequence.

name: safety_posture
description: Summarize the executable section-13 threat model with separate mitigated, declared-only, unmitigated, residual, unanalysed, and unreachable populations. It explicitly reports that modelled declarations are not runtime security controls.

include_threats.description: Include full threat records in addition to the bounded posture summary.

name: security_redteam_simulate
description: Replay the typed section-13 red-team, disclosure, trust-boundary, incident-response, and audit-evidence contracts as one bounded workflow. Confirmed findings alone become regression cells; vulnerability disclosure is sequential and advisory-gated; forbidden or unmodelled crossings refuse; evaluator feedback loops distinguish within-trial isolation from across-trial influence; containment requires complete, resolved lineage; audit chains distinguish observations from assertions. This models and audits contracts only: it does not execute fuzzers, sandboxes, containment, notification, or durable security infrastructure.

findings.description: Finding rows with id, campaign, boundary, class, optional status/reproduction, embargoed, and minimised. Confirmed rows can become regression cells.

vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerability rows with id, class, severity, epoch, optional impact, advisory, and sequential transitions [{to, epoch, note}]. Disclosure requires all advisory fields.

deliveries.description: Boundary intents [{id, kind, origin, to, via}] checked against the shipped two-sandbox evaluation model.

incidents.description: Incident rows with id, class, opened_at, optional blast_radius {completeness, unreachable_edges, dispositions}, requests, timeline, and expected_actions.

audit_records.description: Audit rows with event, actor, subject, epoch, and statement {kind: asserted|observed, ...}; observed statements use closed observation kinds.

attestations.description: Narrow claims such as digests_compared, built_from_manifest, bundle_closure_verified, or independently_reproduced. observed=true is refused unless this process can witness the claim.

boundary_universe.description: Optional boundary universe used to report uncovered regression-cell boundaries.

include_details.description: Include bounded regression cells and audit records in addition to summaries; defaults false.

max_items.description: Bound returned rows in every repeated section; defaults to 100.

name: weave_protocol_catalog

name: workspace_capabilities

name: capability_dashboard

It separates callable MCP tools, authoritative schema coverage, crate ownership, CLI entrypoints, Python artifacts, readiness classes, explicit gaps, digest-verified artifact evidence, and workflow-reconciliation posture; it does not grant permission, execute tools, or claim scientific, clinical, release, or deployment readiness.

domain.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter over declared domain labels.

status.description: Optional exact status filter such as available or planned.

include_tools.description: Include sorted MCP tool names in each group row; defaults false.

include_gaps.description: Include explicit surface-gap labels in each group row; defaults true.

name: repository_catalog
description: Scan the configured repository root into a deterministic documentation/module catalog. Returns hashes, titles, statuses, protected classes, link health, and graph lint counts without dumping document bodies. Use prefix and limit for bounded discovery.

prefix.description: Optional repository-relative module prefix such as docs/ or crates/fiber/.

limit.description: Maximum modules to return; defaults to 200.

include_briefs.description: Include the first-paragraph brief for each returned module.

include_findings.description: Include full graph lint findings in addition to counts.

name: repository_bundle
description: Compile a route-specific documentation context from the repository root. Protected closure, route obligations, traversal completeness, budget failures, and omission influence are preserved; request markdown explicitly when the metadata is insufficient.

route.description: TaskRoute JSON with id, intent, and at least one must_read module id.

max_depth.description: Optional depth cap. A cap makes the resulting completeness partial and never licenses zero-influence omissions.

follow.description: Optional closed edge vocabulary override, for example [requires, references].

include_markdown.description: Include rendered source boundaries and text; defaults to false for progressive disclosure.

max_markdown_chars.description: Hard ceiling for requested markdown; the server fails rather than truncating.

name: repository_impact
description: Compute conservative documentation change impact for one repository module. The result preserves incoming dependency propagation, typed transitivity stops, affected task routes, and scan/link diagnostics; it is not a semantic diff and never claims that every affected module must change.

changed.description: Repository module id present in the scanned documentation graph, for example docs/README.

route.description: Optional serialized TaskRoute to test for invalidation.

routes.description: Optional serialized TaskRoute values; use instead of route for multiple route checks.

name: telemetry_project
description: Project a serialized canonical DomainEvent through a typed RedactionPolicy and return the TelemetryRecord beside its semantic-loss report. Optionally evaluate a serialized observed/asserted metric definition. Unclassified emission, missing treatments, missing observations, asserted-only inputs, and zero denominators remain refusals; no OTLP backend, sampling, span creation, clock read, storage, or network export is performed.

event.description: Serialized bioprism-ops DomainEvent with fields carrying values and ScopeClass labels.

policy.description: Serialized bioprism-ops RedactionPolicy; every event field class needs an explicit emit, coarsen, or drop treatment.

trace.description: Opaque correlation TraceId; it connects records but does not define event identity.

metric.description: Optional serialized MetricDefinition using passthrough, ratio, sum, or difference derivation.

observations.description: Required when metric is supplied: serialized Observations with observed or asserted Sample provenance.

name: project_ingest
description: Scan a root-confined project directory into a fiber-world/0.1 document with its release-readiness pack, scope-dimension document, and generated queries. The scan is static and deterministic: tests are counted never run, markers are substring proxies, manifests go through narrow readers, and every skipped or unread byte is declared in losses_by_kind. With out_dir the emitted documents are written as canonical bytes — without confirm=true the call previews the exact paths and writes nothing. The 'performed' field is null when no out_dir was named, false when one was named and the write awaits confirm=true, and true when the files are on disk.

root.description: Project directory to scan, relative to the server root. Absolute paths, traversal, and symlink escapes are refused.

issues.description: Optional path to a strict JSON issues file (array of {id, title, body?, components?}), relative to the server root. Each issue becomes a fact plus a review factor and query.

decision_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp for the scan event and generated queries. No clock is ever read; omitted means the fixed epoch 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

out_dir.description: Optional directory to write world.json, pack.json, dimensions.json, query.release.json, and query.issue.<id>.json into, relative to the server root.

confirm.description: Must be true for out_dir to actually write; otherwise the call previews the effect.

name: project_audit
description: Scan a root-confined project directory, assemble its world, and compile the release query under the emitted pack's rule oracle end to end. The response carries the verdict with its checkable witnesses (every check a declared static-scan proxy), the scan's loss summary counted by kind, and the compiled evidence region of every declared issue. Nothing is executed, resolved against a registry, or written to disk.

root.description: Project directory to scan, relative to the server root. Absolute paths, traversal, and symlink escapes are refused.

issues.description: Optional path to a strict JSON issues file (array of {id, title, body?, components?}), relative to the server root. Each issue's query is compiled and its selected fact ids returned.

decision_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp for the scan event and generated queries. No clock is ever read; omitted means the fixed epoch 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

name: repair_plan
description: Derive a checkable repair plan for one declared issue from the evidence region compiled for it, and optionally write it as a bioprism-repair-plan/0.1 document. The plan is bound to the world it was planned from — world id, world digest, region fact ids and query digest — so repair_verify can report staleness instead of guessing. Items the generator inferred are marked derived and items the caller declared are marked declared; the two never merge, and a declared name colliding with a derived one is refused rather than absorbed. Nothing is edited, patched, built, or run: this plans and it checks. Meeting every criterion is not proof the issue is resolved, and the plan says so in its own limitations. With out the document is written as canonical bytes — without confirm=true the call previews the exact path and writes nothing; 'performed' is null when no out was named, false when one awaits confirm, and true when the file is on disk.

root.description: Project directory to scan, relative to the server root. Absolute paths, traversal, and symlink escapes are refused.

issues.description: Path to a strict JSON issues file (array of {id, title, body?, components?}), relative to the server root. Required: a plan is for one declared issue, and a tree assembled without its declarations carries no issue to plan for.

issue.description: The id of the issue to plan for. It must be declared in the issues file; an id that is not is refused with the ids that are.

decision_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp for the scan event and generated queries. No clock is ever read; omitted means the fixed epoch 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

criteria.description: Optional path to a bioprism-repair-declarations/0.1 document, relative to the server root, carrying the caller's own criteria (each needing name, statement, predicate and rationale), obligations and falsifiers (name, statement, predicate) plus extra limitations. Undeclared keys are refused; an absent list means the author declared none of that kind.

out.description: Optional path to write the plan document to, relative to the server root.

confirm.description: Must be true for out to actually write; otherwise the call previews the effect.

name: repair_verify
description: Re-scan a project tree and report which of a repair plan's declared criteria held. Three-valued: every criterion, obligation and falsifier is met, unmet, or not_evaluable, and not_evaluable is never folded into either of the others — it carries the obstruction naming the variable that stopped the check. Without a succession declaration, staleness comes first and nothing is evaluated: a different world is reported as 'stale' with a null outcome and no item list. For a changed tree, an optional succession object names the person asserting that this is the planned repair's successor; that claim is carried verbatim and never independently verified. Obligations are reported on a separate admissibility axis and never move the outcome. This never states that the issue is resolved, only which declared criteria held. Nothing is written, built, or run.

root.description: Project directory to scan, relative to the server root. Absolute paths, traversal, and symlink escapes are refused.

plan.description: Path to a bioprism-repair-plan/0.1 document, relative to the server root. Its content-derived plan_id is rederived, so a body edited after the id was minted is refused.

issues.description: Optional path to the issues file the plan was planned from, relative to the server root. Assembling the same tree without its declarations produces a different world, which the plan reports as stale rather than as a verdict.

decision_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp for the scan event and generated queries. No clock is ever read; omitted means the fixed epoch 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

succession.description: Optional caller declaration needed to evaluate a changed world. The tool records this named assertion verbatim and does not verify it.

declared_by.description: Non-empty person or accountable identity making the succession assertion.

statement.description: Non-empty assertion that the scanned world is the repaired successor of the plan's bound world.

name: glioma_research_dry_run

No network, instrument, federation, clinical decision, or biological observation is performed; real providers plug into the research crate's caller-owned executor seam.

name: glioma_workflow_plan

name: glioma_protocol_evidence_surface

Computes inverse-uncertainty information, pooled signal-to-noise, a conservative power proxy, between-site heterogeneity, and leave-one-site-out influence; underpowered and unstable evidence remains explicit and no site or clinical action is dispatched.

request.description: FederatedBenchmarkPowerRequest1@1 with benchmark binding, site/replicate floors, target effect, power/SNR, heterogeneity, and influence gates.

sites.description: FederatedBenchmarkSite1@1 aggregate-only site score summaries and local artifact references.

name: glioma_federated_interpretation
description: Join a validated local glioma closure interpretation with aggregate-only multi-site benchmark consensus. Qualification requires alignment between the local cross-family interpretation and the independent consortium result; heterogeneous, negative, underpowered, contradictory, and unresolved outcomes remain explicit. This route performs analysis only and never moves raw data, executes instruments, or makes clinical decisions.

request.description: FederatedInterpretationRequest1@1 containing ClosureInterpretationRun1@1, matching FederatedBenchmarkRequest1@1, aggregate FederatedBenchmarkSite1@1 entries, and explicit qualification gates.

name: glioma_federated_mechanism_transport
description: Analyze aggregate preclinical glioma mechanism effects across federated model systems without moving raw observations. The deterministic transport analyzer weights site effects by bounded population similarity, quality, replicates, and uncertainty; reports model-system coverage, direction conflict, heterogeneity, site spread, and leave-one-site-out fragility; and preserves underpowered, distant, low-quality, negative, partial, and unresolved outcomes. It never executes an assay, makes a clinical decision, or exports raw data.

request.description: FederatedMechanismTransportRequest1@1 with mechanism/model binding, target signature, replicate/quality floors, similarity scale, effect and transportability gates.

sites.description: FederatedMechanismSite1@1 aggregate-only mechanism effects with bounded population signatures and local artifact references.

name: glioma_federated_mechanism_transport_campaign_execute
description: Run a bounded adaptive aggregate-only preclinical glioma mechanism-transport campaign. Re-ranks institution-local follow-up site actions from current transport heterogeneity, executes deterministic synthetic aggregate summaries in MCP, and replays the transport analyzer after each accepted site. Qualified, heterogeneous, negative, underpowered, failed, budget-blocked, and unresolved states remain explicit; raw traces, human data, instrument commands, and clinical decisions are never moved or produced.

request.description: FederatedMechanismTransportCampaignRequest1@1 with aggregate transport binding, initial sites, typed follow-up actions, budget, round/retry bounds, and stop policy.

name: glioma_federated_benchmark_site_plan
description: Plan a conservative aggregate-only expansion of a preclinical glioma benchmark consortium. Bounded beam search evaluates candidate sites and replicate portfolios against the real consensus analyzer, accounting for budget, privacy risk, independent-study identity, heterogeneity, signal, spread, and leave-one-site-out influence. Projections are scenarios, not observations; no raw data or clinical decision is produced.

request.description: FederatedBenchmarkSitePlannerRequest1@1 with benchmark thresholds, current aggregate sites, candidate site scenarios, budget/privacy bounds, beam width, and conservatism setting.

name: glioma_federated_benchmark_campaign_execute
description: Run a bounded autonomous federated glioma benchmark campaign. Replans deterministic follow-up actions from aggregate-only consensus pressure, executes institution-local synthetic aggregates in MCP, and preserves qualified, heterogeneous, negative, underpowered, failed, budget-blocked, and unresolved outcomes. Raw traces, clinical decisions, and instrument effects remain out of scope.

request.description: FederatedBenchmarkCampaignRequest1@1 with benchmark binding, initial aggregate sites, typed follow-up actions, budget, round/retry bounds, and stop policy.

name: glioma_federated_benchmark_operating_cycle
description: Run the complete aggregate-only federated glioma benchmark operating cycle: enforce local aggregate boundaries, compute consensus, execute bounded follow-up actions, and return a governance handoff. MCP uses synthetic site aggregates and never moves raw traces, executes instruments, or makes a clinical decision.

request.description: FederatedBenchmarkOperatingCycleRequest1@1 containing FederatedBenchmarkCampaignRequest1@1, aggregate-only boundary policy, and execution_mode local_simulation or governed_local.

name: glioma_federated_adaptive_campaign_execute
description: Compile a conservative aggregate-only federated glioma site portfolio into an executable benchmark campaign. The controller turns influence-aware planner scenarios into typed follow-up actions, executes them through a deterministic synthetic aggregate worker, and keeps projected versus observed qualification, heterogeneity, negative, partial, blocked, and no-plan states distinct. Institutions retain raw data and execution authority; MCP never moves raw traces, executes instruments, or makes clinical decisions.

request.description: FederatedBenchmarkAdaptiveCampaignRequest1@1 with benchmark/site-planner inputs, round/retry bounds, aggregate-only policy, and stop controls.

name: glioma_replay_campaign_execute
description: Run a bounded dependency-aware reproducibility replay campaign for a preclinical glioma research object. Replays declared program tasks through a local executor seam, compares exact content hashes, blocks dependants after mismatches or unavailable outputs, and preserves reproducible, partial, non-reproducible, blocked, and unresolved release-readiness states. MCP uses a synthetic worker; no raw data or clinical decision is produced.

request.description: ReplayCampaignRequest1@1 with ResearchObjectRequest1@1, acyclic replay tasks, exact expected artifact hashes, dependency/cost declarations, coverage gate, budget, and retry bounds.

name: glioma_replay_history_reconcile
description: Reconcile already validated archival replay campaign summaries across expected epochs and opaque site commitments. Produces a bounded digest-chained aggregate with reproducible, divergent, insufficient, and unresolved states. It does not retrieve archives, rerun code, authenticate sites, move raw data, sign or publish research, or make clinical decisions.

request.description: ReplayHistoryRequest1@1 with research and manifest identity, at least two ordered expected epochs, a minimum two-site quorum, and already validated ReplayCampaign1@1 rows keyed by opaque site commitments.

name: glioma_local_release_workflow_execute
description: Run a local single-study release workflow: compile the multimodal package, verify dependency closure, execute dependency-aware replay only after closure succeeds, evaluate accountable release predicates, and return an operator handoff. MCP uses a synthetic replay worker; it never signs, uploads, publishes, moves raw data, or makes a clinical decision.

request.description: GliomaLocalReleaseWorkflowRequest1@1 with matching MultimodalResearchObjectRequest1@1 and ReplayCampaignRequest1@1, dependency depth/program coverage policy, and ReleaseGateRequest1@1.

name: glioma_multistudy_release_reconcile
description: Reconcile two to 64 per-study local release workflows for one preclinical research portfolio. Preserves expected-cohort coverage and each study's release state using opaque commitments and content digests; portfolio readiness requires every expected study to be ready for its own accountable signing review. Does not merge artifacts, authenticate identities, sign, publish, move raw data, or make clinical decisions.

request.description: MultiStudyReleaseRequest1@1 with one research_id, 2-64 sorted expected study commitments, and bounded P11-F13 workflow reports keyed by those commitments.

name: glioma_release_batch_execute
description: Run a bounded prospective release queue for preclinical single-study workflows. Preflights every candidate before dispatch, orders jobs deterministically by priority/submission, enforces one shared replay budget and workflow cap, defers jobs that cannot be admitted, and stops on unaccounted execution failure. MCP uses a synthetic replay worker and does not perform external effects.

request.description: ReleaseBatchRequest1@1 with batch_id, total_budget_units, max_workflows, and 1-128 ReleaseBatchItem1@1 values containing unique job_id/submission_order, priority, and a GliomaLocalReleaseWorkflowRequest1@1.

name: glioma_federated_continual_release_reconcile
description: Reconcile successive federated release portfolio snapshots for one expected study cohort. Detects missing epochs, continuity gaps, held or unresolved studies, and per-study manifest changes; changed manifests require an independent review quorum bound to the old and new digest. Reviewer and site commitments are caller-supplied and not authenticated. Does not sign, publish, upload, contact sites, move raw data, or make clinical decisions.

request.description: FederatedContinualReleaseRequest1@1 with research_id, 2-32 strictly ordered expected epochs, 2-64 sorted expected study commitments, minimum independent change approval count, bounded P11-F14 portfolio reports, and change reviews bound to exact previous/current manifest digests.

name: glioma_local_release_review_packet_compile
description: Compile a fixed local reproducibility-steward checklist from one validated P11-F13 workflow. Checklist items cover package/provenance, dependency closure, replay, release-gate findings, and limitations/negative evidence. Responses bind to exact checklist commitments and preserve pending, corrective, and unresolved states. Reviewer identity and independence are caller assertions, and completion does not authorize, sign, or publish a research object.

request.description: LocalReleaseReviewPacketRequest1@1 with one validated GliomaLocalReleaseWorkflow1@1, opaque reviewer_commitment, reviewer_role, independent_reviewer_claim, and up to five unique ReleaseChecklistResponse1@1 values keyed by checklist item commitments. Each response contains a decision and caller-supplied response_digest.

name: glioma_portfolio_review_workbench_reconcile
description: Reconcile one P11-F14 expected cohort report with up to 64 P11-F17 local human review packets. Checks exact workflow digest and disposition binding and reports every expected study as complete, pending, corrective, unresolved, held, blocked, divergent, or missing. Does not merge study artifacts, authenticate study/reviewer identities, satisfy signer quorum, authorize release, sign, or publish.

request.description: PortfolioReviewWorkbenchRequest1@1 with a validated MultiStudyReleaseReport1@1 and up to 64 PortfolioReviewPacketInput1@1 values. Each value maps one opaque study_commitment to a validated LocalReleaseReviewPacket1@1 from the matching P11-F13 workflow digest.

name: glioma_release_batch_review_workbench_reconcile
description: Reconcile up to 128 P11-F17 local review packets against a validated P11-F15 release queue. Binds each packet to the exact produced job workflow digest and disposition, preserves queue order, and retains all budget-deferred, failed, and not-attempted jobs. Reviewer identities are not authenticated, and review queue completion does not authorize, sign, or publish a research object.

request.description: ReleaseBatchReviewWorkbenchRequest1@1 with a validated ReleaseBatchReport1@1 and up to 128 ReleaseBatchReviewPacketInput1@1 values. Each value maps one job_id to a validated LocalReleaseReviewPacket1@1 with the exact P11-F15 workflow_digest.

name: glioma_local_release_signature_payload_prepare
description: Prepare the exact compact JSON bytes an institution-controlled signer must sign for a ready local research-object release. Binds the manifest, P11-F13 workflow, completed P11-F17 checklist, P11-F20 release gate, key identifier, public-key digest, and caller challenge. Never accepts a private key, authenticates signer or key authority, prevents challenge replay, authorizes release, or publishes.

context.description: LocalReleaseSignatureContext1@1 with one validated P11-F13 workflow, matching complete P11-F17 review packet, signer_key_id, 32-byte signer_public_key, and caller-supplied challenge_digest.

name: glioma_local_release_signature_verify
description: Verify an externally produced detached Ed25519 signature over the P11-F21 release payload. A valid signature establishes mathematical key possession for these bytes only; signer identity, institutional key authority, challenge freshness, release authorization, and publication are outside this verifier.

request.description: LocalReleaseSignatureVerificationRequest1@1 with LocalReleaseSignatureContextRequest1@1 and a 64-byte detached_signature.

name: glioma_release_trust_policy_payload_prepare
description: Prepare exact compact policy bytes for an institutional trust-root signer. The policy binds a sorted, bounded set of Ed25519 release-key grants to a research identity, approval purpose, validity interval, and optional revocation time. The caller must sign the returned bytes using a policy authority outside this service.

policy.description: ReleaseTrustPolicy1@1 with policy_id, authority_key_id, and 1 to 128 grants sorted by (signer_key_id, research_id). Each grant has signer_public_key, exact research_id, the P11 local release approval purpose, validity bounds, and optional revocation time.

name: glioma_release_trust_policy_evaluate
description: Evaluate an F21 mathematical signature against a root-signed, project-scoped release-key policy. Requires the local operator's configured root key ID, public key, and expected public-key digest. A trusted key may proceed to accountable release-approval review; this result does not authorize publication or check challenge replay.

request.description: ReleaseTrustPolicyEvaluationRequest1@1 containing LocalReleaseSignatureVerification1@1, ReleaseTrustPolicy1@1, pinned_authority_key_id, 32-byte pinned_authority_public_key, pinned_authority_key_digest, 64-byte policy_signature, and observed_at_unix_seconds.

name: glioma_research_object_release_gate
description: Evaluate whether a preclinical glioma research-object replay campaign satisfies the declared release predicates for accountable signing review. Checks exact coverage, hash agreement, manifest status, uncertainty, negative evidence, and independent review attestations while preserving every blocker and remediation. Publishable means ready for human signing review only; MCP never signs, publishes, moves raw data, or makes a clinical decision.

request.description: ReleaseGateRequest1@1 with coverage/hash/reproducibility thresholds, uncertainty bound, approval quorum, and review attestations.
